settings.title: Project configuration
settings.subtitle: RAG thresholds and the project's template version. Every change is proposed, approved by another person and audited; nothing already recorded is changed retroactively.

rag.valuesShort: green ≤ {green} · amber ≤ {amber} working days of slip · stale after {stale} days
rag.noProjectVersion: No project version has been approved yet: the template's proposed default applies.
rag.rulesTitle: What each status means under the thresholds in force
rag.proposed: Threshold version {version} proposed — it applies only once approved

fields.greenHint: Forecast finish at most this many working days after the baselined finish.
fields.amberHint: Above it the status is red. Must not be below the green value.
fields.staleHint: Without an accepted update for longer, the status is Data stale — never green.

form.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number of days.
form.amberBelowGreen: The amber limit cannot be below the green limit.
form.effectPending: A new threshold version is recorded as a proposal; the thresholds in force do not change.
form.effectApprover: Another person with the approval permission (portfolio administration) approves or rejects it — never the proposer.

rag.ownProposal: You proposed this change: another person approves it. You may withdraw it.
rag.youDecide: You can approve or reject this change.
rag.awaiting: Awaiting approval by a portfolio administrator.
rag.approveEffect: Version {version} is in force from now on; every calculated RAG names it.
rag.approveEffectHistory: Accepted status updates keep the status frozen when they were accepted.
rag.rejectEffect: The proposal is rejected; the thresholds in force stay unchanged.
rag.withdrawEffect: The proposal is withdrawn; the thresholds in force stay unchanged.
rag.approved: Threshold version {version} approved and in force

upgrade.pinnedHint: The project stays on this version until an upgrade is approved. A newer version never reshapes the project by itself.
upgrade.noneAvailable: No newer version of this template is published.
upgrade.previewTitle: Preview — what moving to version {to} would change
upgrade.previewHint: Computed from the project's current records. Nothing is changed by a preview.
upgrade.cannotPropose: Proposing an upgrade needs the project manager or portfolio administration.
upgrade.proposeEffect: The upgrade to version {to} is proposed exactly as previewed; the project stays on its version.
upgrade.proposeEffectApprover: The sponsor approves or rejects it — never the proposer. If the project or the template changes meanwhile, the approval is refused and the upgrade must be previewed again.
upgrade.openTitle: Upgrade from version {from} to version {to} awaiting approval
upgrade.stale: The project or the template changed since this preview: an approval would be refused. Reject it and propose the upgrade again.
upgrade.ownProposal: You proposed this upgrade: another person approves it.
upgrade.youDecide: You can approve or reject this upgrade.
upgrade.approveEffect: The project moves to version {to} now, exactly as previewed.
upgrade.approveEffectCreates: Created as proposals: gates {gates}, workstreams {workstreams}, activities {activities}, KPIs {kpis}.
upgrade.approveEffectKeeps: Existing records are not changed or removed; any change to them goes through their own commands.
upgrade.rejectEffect: The upgrade is rejected; the project stays on its version.
upgrade.applied: Upgrade applied — the project is on version {to}

plan.versionOnly: Only the version number changes: nothing is created, kept aside or re-worded.
plan.addTitle: Created in the project when approved
plan.addHint: New in this version and not yet in the project — created as proposals (draft activities, gates not started, KPIs proposed).
plan.keepHint: Removed or changed in the new version: the project's records are not changed retroactively. Change them through their own commands if needed.
plan.nothingKept: No existing record differs from the new version.
plan.textsTitle: Read from the new version once approved
plan.kpisArabic: Arabic texts of the formula, source and thresholds of template KPIs: {count}
plan.phases: Phase list shown on the overview (added, removed or changed): {count}
plan.dimensions: Status dimensions added (computed after the upgrade): {count}
plan.readiness: Default readiness checks offered by "checklist from template" on the Day-1 screen: {count}
plan.ragChangedApplies: Template default RAG thresholds change from {from} to {to} — they apply, as the project has no approved threshold version.
plan.ragChangedNotApplied: Template default RAG thresholds change from {from} to {to} — no effect: the project's approved threshold version stays in force.

settings.title: Step 7 — Confidentiality, retention, integrations and AI mode
settings.hint: Set how the project is protected from the start. The AI stays Off unless an authorized role enables it; integrations show their real status.
settings.policiesHint: Set while the project is in setup. Recorded as reviewed — a required onboarding item.
settings.classificationHint: Who may see the project: only people cleared at or above this level. Offered up to your own clearance.
settings.retentionHint: As set by the organization's records policy.
settings.retentionTbd: To be confirmed (stays on the gap list)
settings.retentionRange: Enter {min}–{max} years, or mark it to be confirmed.
settings.loweringHint: Lowering the classification widens who can see the project; the reason is audited.
settings.readOnly: Only the project manager sets them.
settings.afterLaunch: Set during setup; the project has been launched.
settings.retentionEnforcement: The retention period is recorded for the project; automatic retention enforcement is not implemented yet (planned with records retention, P7).
settings.aiHint: Every project starts with the AI Off. The mode is changed in the AI PM Center by an authorized role.
settings.aiWho: The sponsor or portfolio administration changes the AI mode.
settings.integrationsHint: Organization connections with their real status: Verified only after a real connectivity check.
settings.integrationsNone: No integration is configured for the organization.
settings.integrationsWho: Connections are managed in Administration by platform administrators.

launch.title: Step 8 — Launch monitoring
launch.hint: Monitoring starts only when every required onboarding item is approved through its own command. Remaining gaps are listed explicitly and recorded with the launch.
launch.noGaps: No gap: every required item is done.

warningHint.no_sources: no source document has been registered for the project.
warningHint.retention_tbd: the retention period is still to be confirmed.

launch.blockedHint: Complete the open items first — each through its own screen and approver.
launch.ackHint: Acknowledge each remaining gap to launch.
launch.readyHint: Ready: launching sets the project to Active and records the acknowledged gaps.
launch.effectActive: The project leaves setup and becomes Active.
launch.effectGaps: Recorded with the launch as acknowledged gaps: {gaps}.
launch.launched: Monitoring launched — the project is Active
launch.checklistHint: Computed from the current records. The roles shown approve or complete each item on its own screen; the wizard approves nothing.

templates.hint: Template versions are published from reviewed template files. A project keeps its version; it moves to a newer one only through an approved upgrade on its configuration screen.

diff.kpiTextsArabicOnly: KPIs with Arabic texts added or corrected
diff.ragPolicyChanged: RAG policy changed (default thresholds or rules)

deployment.hint: The configuration the platform is running with. It is changed by the operators in the deployment configuration, not on this screen.
deployment.noSecrets: No secret is shown: passwords, keys and connection strings never leave the server — only whether each part is configured and the host names it talks to.
deployment.egressNone: None — no outbound host is allowed.
deployment.linkByEmail: First sign-in links accounts by verified e-mail
deployment.unscanned: Files without a malware scan may be downloaded
deployment.warningsHint: Accepted but noteworthy settings, as written in the server log at start-up.

codes.rag_amber_below_green: The amber limit cannot be below the green limit.
codes.rag_slip_out_of_range: Slip limits are at most 260 working days.
codes.rag_stale_out_of_range: The freshness window is 1 to 90 days.
codes.rag_unchanged: These are already the thresholds in force — nothing to propose.
codes.rag_proposal_pending: Another threshold change is awaiting a decision: it must be approved, rejected or withdrawn first.
codes.rag_basis_changed: The thresholds in force changed since this proposal: withdraw it and propose again.
codes.rag_not_proposer: Only the person who proposed the change can withdraw it.
codes.rag_payload_changed: The proposal no longer matches what was submitted and cannot be decided.
codes.rag_invalid_transition: This threshold change has already been decided.
codes.upgrade_proposal_pending: Another template upgrade of this project awaits a decision.
codes.upgrade_preview_changed: The project or the template changed since this preview: preview again before proposing.
codes.upgrade_preview_stale: The project or the template changed since the preview the approval refers to: reject the upgrade and propose it again.
codes.upgrade_invalid_transition: This template upgrade has already been decided.
codes.upgrade_not_newer: Only a newer version of the project's template can be applied.
codes.upgrade_not_published: Only a published template version can be applied.
codes.upgrade_other_template: A project can only move to another version of its own template.
codes.setup_launch_blocked: Monitoring cannot be launched while required onboarding items are open.
codes.setup_gaps_not_acknowledged: Acknowledge the remaining gaps before launching.
codes.setup_not_in_setup: The project has already left setup.
codes.setup_policies_after_launch: Confidentiality and retention are set in the wizard only while the project is in setup.
codes.setup_retention_out_of_range: The retention period is 1 to 100 years, or to be confirmed.
codes.setup_classification_lowered_reason_requ: Give the reason for lowering the project classification.
codes.setup_pm_clearance_too_low: A project manager's clearance is below this classification: the project would be hidden from them.
